notes: This portable C++ TCK slice joins a subject and a distinct requester to a federation containing the adapter-supplied FOM and standard MIM. The subject makes no successful Update Attribute Values invocation. The requester subscribes to and requests the subject's standard HLAreportObjectInstancesUpdated, then verifies exactly one reliable report with the standard HLAobjectInstanceCounts parameter in the MIM-defined NULL/empty-list state. A zero-length parameter payload is treated as an undefined value; a nonempty payload is decoded as the standard HLAobjectClassBasedCounts variable array and must contain no elements. The test uses only official IEEE 1516.1 RTIambassador and FederateAmbassador APIs, standard data elements, and the C++ standard library. Provider package, FOM, endpoint, callback configuration, and logical-time implementation are adapter inputs; no private headers, provider registries, application-specific attributes, DDM regions, or vendor-specific names are used.

api_surfaces.owner: IEEE 1516.1 C++ API and IEEE 1516.2 standard MIM
api_surfaces.signature: RTIambassador standard MIM composition, joined-federate updated-object request, interaction subscription, and lifecycle; FederateAmbassador interaction callback; standard decoding of the empty class-count list
api_surfaces.source_symbol: RTIambassador::createFederationExecutionWithMIM, joinFederationExecution, getInteractionClassHandle, getParameterHandle, getTransportationTypeHandle, subscribeInteractionClass, sendInteraction, unsubscribeInteractionClass, and standard lifecycle services; FederateAmbassador::receiveInteraction
